full_suite.execution: one Python process, complete suite, no per-module isolation

minimum_qt.scope: UI refresh costs, native lifetime and theme switching

idle_profile.setup: default 3-block project, 1705 widgets, 1600x980; cProfile, 3 seconds; worker stopped in both runs

stress_setup: One live MainWindow with TransportWorker, 6-block unified demo, mixed SEQ/LIVE Musical Kit, macros, voice selection, mode, Undo/Redo, seek and theme changes; capturing MIDI output.

theme_profile_stopped.setup: 6-block unified demo, worker stopped, one Midnight to Solar change, cProfile

limitations: Native crash did not recur in these runs. Exact C++ instruction behind the original user malloc_consolidate failure has not been established.
Theme switching under playback remains expensive; stress maximum theme operation was 6640.87 ms, p95 UI gap 1043.89 ms. This is not a claim of stutter-free UI.
No physical MIDI device or audio loopback was tested.
Local timing depends on CPU load and project. Idle CPU ratio is not an overall playback speedup.
An earlier incomplete full-suite run stalled around test 447. Its cause was not established; the subsequent instrumented full run completed all 1873 tests.
